description: This is a JavaScript source file defining a UI component named 'ForecastList' using the LightningJS framework. The component represents a horizontally scrollable list of forecast items, with properties for customization, event handling, and focus management.

classes.name: ForecastList
classes.description: A horizontally scrollable forecast list component for displaying daily/hourly weather forecast items.

methods.name: focusIndex
methods.description: Programmatically focus a given index within the list, bounded by the list size.

methods.name: getSelectedItem
methods.description: Returns the currently selected forecast item.

methods.name: handleEnter
methods.description: Invokes the onEnter callback with the selected item when the user presses enter.
